scope: H16 close-intent corrected process-loss/same-clock test and two added bounded own-run selector regressions; unchanged production identity confirmation

static_assessment: All four production files are byte-identical to the prior 0C/0I bounded intent review. The projection test file is also unchanged.

The corrected same-clock scenario performs the actual guarded scripted POST/ACK, injects loss before _observe commit, and recovers only the actual claim intent. The subsequent first partial reconciliation therefore does not attempt to replace a different dispatch observation at the same immutable timestamp.

The test requires same-clock native partial publication to fail without replacing the intent receipt; it then advances the actual controlled clock and obtains a genuinely later issued position read before successful partial publication. No timestamp is incremented by product code or stored result invented.

The two new storage tests use real claims to check own-run and role filtering, original claim timestamps, strict page bounds excluding bool, read-only total_changes, and a real second-connection append while materializing selected operations. They exercise storage ownership/page/fence behavior without asserting native execution.
